The build log you pasted shows just warnings—no errors:

• Application bundle finished in ~6 s  
• Two CommonJS warnings for `lz-string` and `file-saver`  
• Output location printed

That means the production build completed successfully and the artifacts are in `dist/destiny-chronicle`.

About the warnings  
Angular flags any dependency that only ships a CommonJS build because those modules can’t benefit from certain optimizations. You have three options:

1. Do nothing  
   They are only warnings and won’t affect runtime.

2. Silence them (quick)  
   Add an `allowedCommonJsDependencies` list under the build options in `angular.json`:

```jsonc
"options": {
  /* existing fields … */
  "allowedCommonJsDependencies": ["lz-string", "file-saver"]
}
```

3. Replace with ESM-friendly versions (long-term)  
   • For `lz-string`, you could import one of the many small ESM LZ-string forks or bundle your own  
   • For `file-saver`, switch to `file-saver-es` (identical API but ESM).

If you’d like me to implement option 2 or explore ESM replacements, just let me know. Otherwise, everything is good to go!
